title: Registry entry servers/<id>.json
description: One community in the registry. Mirrors docs/registry-format.md of the launcher repository. String lengths are counted in UTF-16 code units, as the launcher counts them. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored.

id.description: Also the file name without .json; unique.

mirrors.description: 1 to 8 https base URLs ending in /, no credentials, query or fragment; most preferred first.

community.description: Optional https link to the community's own chat (any messenger).

digests.description: Path relative to a mirror base URL (no .., no leading / or backslash) to the lowercase hex SHA-256 of that file.

theme.description: Optional path of theme.json (docs/themes.md); it and every image it names must be listed in digests.

about.description: Optional path of about.json (docs/server-page.md); must be listed in digests.

terms.description: Optional language code to path of a Markdown file; en is required; every path must be listed in digests.
